mobile_crew_settings_allow_bypass_detail: Off hides Bypass and moves every crewmate that can ask back to Ask. Protected paths ask in every mode.
mobile_crew_settings_allow_bypass_unatte: Crewmates on engines with no approval channel (Codex, OpenCode) always run without asking, so their tasks are refused while Bypass is off.
mobile_crew_settings_default_mode_detail: A new crewmate starts in this mode. Crewmates you already have keep theirs.
